channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Audio, Sound & Music, Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Audio, Sound & Music, Worldwide, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 15 Jun 2026 (15 Jun to 21 Jun 2026).

  • Revitalizing Rituals 2026 Open Call
    Homo Faber Alapítvány (Homo Faber Foundation) · deadline Closed 19 Jul 2026 · EUR 6,000 gross artist fee and production budget; international travel and per diems covered; on-site accommodation provided. No application fee.
  • AdK / EMS Berlin-Stockholm Bilateral Residency Program 2026-27
    Studio für Elektroakustische Musik, Akademie der Künste (Berlin) and Elektronmusikstudion EMS (Stockholm) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · Travel and accommodation costs for stays in Berlin and Stockholm covered; fees paid for presentation at KONTAKTE Festival 2027 (Berlin) and for presentation...
